translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Beṉ'ka' nak to guiyoa tapiyona mil
Ka biyoll ble'id' diiki, bizle'id' tap anjl zechagake' tap ḻaate yell-lioni, chzag'gake' be'na' za' tap ḻaate kwenc̱he bibi be' se lo yell-lioni ni lo nisdo'na' na' ni lo yagka'.

Ḻekzka' ble'id' sto anjl zee gana' chla'lə wbilla', na' nox̱ee sey c̱he Chios yaa Chios banna'. Na' besyaa anjli zillj inlleb wṉie' anjlka' tap, beṉ'ka' gok lo na'gake' yeḻ' waka' kwenc̱he gak wlliayi'gake' diika' de lo yell-liona' na' ḻoo nisdo'na', na' chi'e ḻegake':
―Bibi gonile yell-lioni, nisdo'na', ni yagdo'ka' shlak biṉ' wda'cho seya' loxga beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Chios c̱hechona'.
Na' benid' ka'k' beṉ'ka' wda' seya' loxgue'ka', na' nakgake' to guiyoa tapiyona mil beṉ', beṉ'ka' nak shlliṉ kwen dia c̱he dii Israela'.
Shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Judána', shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Rubénna', shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Gada',
shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Asera', shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Neftalína', shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Manaséza',
shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Simeónna', shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Levína', shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Isacara',
shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Zabulónna', shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Joséna', na' zi shlliṉa mil beṉ'ka' nak dia c̱he dii Benjamínna'.
Beṉ' be beṉ' zil beṉ'ka' zoa do xtil

Ka biyoll dga, na'ch bwia' na' ble'id' beṉ' zan inlleb, beṉ' za' doxen yell-lioni, na' lo wde wdeli dia, na' beṉ' chṉe wde wdeli dill', na' beṉ' za' yog' yell. Zegake' lao beena' llia chṉabia' na' lao Beena' Zaklebi to Xil'do', na' kono ibabi ḻegake' daa nakgake' beṉ' be beṉ' zil inlleb. Na' nakwgake' twej xagake' dii xtil na' nox̱'gake' twej zin.
Na' yog'ḻoḻzgake' chosyaagake' zillj inlleb, nagake':

content.text: Chios c̱hechona', beena' llia gana' chṉabi'e,

content: Na' yog'ḻoḻ anjlka' nec̱hjgake' beena' llia chṉabia', na' beṉ'ka' tapichoa len beṉ'ka' tap, bc̱hek' xibe'ka' lawe'na' ax̱t lo yona' bllin loxgue'ka', na' be'la'ogake' Chioza',

content.text: ¡Kan' nakan! Toshiizi we'la'ocho Chios c̱hechoni, na' koochone' balaaṉ,
na' we'cho dill' ka nak yeḻ' sin' c̱he'na', na' we'chone' yeḻ' chox̱ken,
na' we'cho dill' nake' beṉ' zakii nlleb, beṉ' chṉabia' doxen, na' beṉ' yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen. ¡Kan' nakan!

content: Na' to beena' len beṉ'ka' tapichoa wṉabile' nad': ―¿Nora beṉ'ki nakw lech' xtila'? ¿Gara za'gake', lla?
Na' goshee: ―Li'kz ṉezilo' daa, beṉ'do'. Na' ḻe' wne' nad': Beṉ'kin ba bichej lo yeḻ' zak'zi' xenna', na' ba biyib bix̱isi xe'ka' xc̱hen Beena' Zaklebi to Xil'do', na' daan nakwgake' lech' xtila'.
Daan, zegake' lao Chioza' gana' zoe' chṉabi'e na' ka waḻ ka tella choe'la'ogake'ne'. Na' Chioza', beena' llia chṉabi'a soalene' ḻegake' na' gap wwie' ḻegake'.
Bich ibiḻ idongake', ni bich wzey wbilldo'na' ḻegake', ni bich gakgakile' zey',

ḻa' Beena' Zaklebi to Xil'do', beena' zoa gana' chi' Chioza' chṉabi'e, gap wwie' ḻegake'. Na' wc̱hi'e ḻegake' gana' chal nisa' daa nsa' yeḻ' mbanna'. Na' Chioza' wkwase' yog'ḻoḻ daa chkwellyeshaan ḻegake'.
